text.card: A red giant 2,012 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 0.93 solar masses and 8.2 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,663 K at its surface.
